description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which serves as a basic contract for logging components within an Android application. It specifies a method for outputting log data to connected nodes, supporting chaining and filtering of logs.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for logging nodes that can output logs and potentially chain to other nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, to the log target.
